description: Improving support for various apps and controls on Windows 11
changelog:
* NVDA 2026.2 (64-bit) or later is required.
* Removed app module for File Explorer.
* In Windows 11 Version 26H2 Start menu, NVDA will no longer announce 'all tabs' when entering search text instead of announcing the top search result.
